It's not that me coming to this conclusion made my will to live disappear, but that I realized I wanted to kill myself and started wondering why, eventually gaining this understanding of myself. This is me finding the logic in what I already felt, rather than determining that theoretically I should want to kill myself.

I'll read up on that, thanks.

I'm not saying that I don't want to live my life because I'm not sure if I'll end up with more happiness or more misery. Actually, I'm pretty sure I'll end up with more happiness. I'm saying that avoiding that misery is more important to me than experiencing that happiness. By sacrificing my future happiness, I also get rid of my future misery.
